## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem It Solves

Describe the problem or use case this feature would address.  
Example: "I'm always frustrated when..."

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working.

## Alternative Solutions

Are there alternative approaches you've considered? Describe them here.

## Compatibility with Python Version

Does the Python `add-apt-repository` have this feature?
- [ ] Yes, this exists in the Python version
- [ ] No, this is a new feature proposal
- [ ] I'm not sure

If yes, please describe how the Python version behaves.

## Additional Context

Add any other context, screenshots, or examples about the feature request here.

## Checklist

- [ ] I have searched existing issues to avoid duplicates
- [ ] I have checked if this feature exists in the Python version
- [ ] This feature maintains backward compatibility with Python version
